```json
{
  "dataset_name": "compass",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "normalized_decile_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "COMPAS recidivism decile score normalized to [0,1] range for smooth linear margin separation",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct linear projection of COMPAS risk assessment onto SVM margin",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "decile_score.1 / 9.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_violence_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "COMPAS violence decile score normalized to [0,1] range",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures violent recidivism risk as continuous feature for linear separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "v_decile_score / 9.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "composite_risk_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of recidivism and violence decile scores, with recidivism weighted higher",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Single smooth composite risk signal combining both COMPAS dimensions for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(0.6 * decile_score.1 + 0.4 * v_decile_score) / 9.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_priors_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed prior offense count normalized by training set max, reducing skew for linear models",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "criminal_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smoothed prior offense signal with reduced outlier influence for linear SVM margin",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(priors_count) / np.log1p(43.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "juvenile_offense_severity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted sum of juvenile offense counts with felonies weighted highest, normalized by training max",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "criminal_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures juvenile criminal history severity as continuous feature for linear separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((3.0 * juv_fel_count + 2.0 * juv_misd_count + 1.0 * juv_other_count) / 60.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_risk_inverse",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Inverse age-based risk score where younger individuals have higher scores, normalized to [0,1]",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "demographics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures age-related recidivism pattern as smooth continuous feature for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "1.0 - np.clip((age - 18.0) / (77.0 - 18.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "charge_severity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Numeric encoding of charge degree severity mapped to continuous scale, higher values indicate more severe charges",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "charge_info",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous charge severity signal for linear SVM margin computation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(1.0 - (c_charge_degree / 10.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "risk_age_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between normalized COMPAS score and inverse age risk, capturing young high-risk individuals",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures nonlinear interaction between age and risk score as linear feature for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(decile_score.1 / 9.0) * (1.0 - np.clip((age - 18.0) / (77.0 - 18.0), 0.0, 1.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "priors_age_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of log prior counts to age, capturing offense rate relative to life experience",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized offense rate per year of life as smooth linear feature",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(priors_count) / np.log1p(age), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "score_text_ordinal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal encoding of COMPAS score text category (Low=0, Medium=0.5, High=1) as continuous feature",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth ordinal risk category encoding for linear SVM boundary",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "score_text / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "total_criminal_history_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Combined criminal history score integrating priors and juvenile offenses with log smoothing",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "criminal_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Comprehensive criminal history signal as single normalized feature for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.log1p(priors_count) / np.log1p(43.0)) * 0.7 + ((juv_fel_count + juv_misd_count + juv_other_count) / 33.0) * 0.3, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "risk_score_divergence",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of divergence between recidivism and violence risk scores; high divergence may indicate specialized risk profile. Score 0 means scores are aligned, 1 means maximum divergence between the two COMPAS dimensions.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures cases where recidivism and violence risk profiles diverge, providing additional discriminative signal for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(decile_score.1 - v_decile_score) / 9.0"
    }
  ]
}
```
